title: Quick-Fix Venezuelan Plantains Empanadas
description: A quick and flavorful Venezuelan-inspired empanada recipe featuring panang paste, brined plantains, and a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: Peel and slice the plantains into 1-inch rounds.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, panang paste, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Gradually add the brine solution to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired empanada size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a few slices of plantain in the center of each circle, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Add a sprinkle of shredded cheese and chopped cilantro on top of the plantains.
Fold the dough in half over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with olive oil and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
